title: Lightning handshake: ropes and asks
summary: One-page ad-hoc rollup of cross-team handoffs, sticky asks, and a tiny coverage metric row for quick partner syncs. Lightweight, meant for 10-min stand and async followups.
content:
Purpose:
- Short (one-screen) tracker for the next 7 days of cross-team handoffs we need to land before the client pilot on 2026-10-15. Keep it minimal: owner, team, ask, blocker, ETA, followup channel.

CURRENT ROWS (human-readable mini-sheet):
Columns: ITEM | OWNER | TEAM | PRIORITY | ETA | STATUS | BLOCKER / NOTES | FOLLOWUP
1) Pilot canary callback endpoint | Ethan Liu | eng-platform | P0 | 2026-10-09 | in_progress | infra quota request open (JIRA-7821) | #infra-oncall + DM Ethan
2) Dedicated capacity quota bump (EU) | Maya Patel | sales-govt | P0 | 2026-10-11 | awaiting_action | billing commit needs legal signoff (legal:LAU-19) | sales-thread + legal-ops
3) Eval prompt set finalization | Priya Desai | product-hosted-api | P1 | 2026-10-10 | in_review | missing edge-case prompts from SE (Maya) | seq: capture in /confluence link
4) Fallback model mapping doc | Louis Becker | eng-serving-runtime | P1 | 2026-10-12 | todo | needs compatibility matrix for tiny-latency models | PR: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/2145
5) Day-of-launch coverage roster | TBC | ops | P2 | 2026-10-14 | draft | two on-call slots open (APAC overlap) | handback in this doc

MICRO-METRICS (one-liners):
- Expected token burn on pilot week (est): 120k tokens/day -> cost estimate flagged to finance (see JIRA-7830).
- Expected 95th pct latency delta if prefix-caching enabled: ~12ms (approx).

STICKY ASKS (quick bullets):
- Legal: accelerate review for reserved-capacity TOS change (owner: Maya).
- SRE: confirm hot-restart blameless window is 30 mins for dedicated pool (owner: Ethan).
- SE: provide final 10 prompts to be used in canary eval (owner: Priya).

NOTES TO SELF / QUICK RISKS: (informal)
- If billing commit stalls >48h, fallback plan is to use burst pool and annotate cost impact in the pilot notes.
- APAC overlap: we only have one APAC engineer aligned; consider shift swap or on-call buddy.
- Canary success criteria: 99.5% token success, no client-facing timeouts >2s on initial 100 requests.

ACTIONS (short ownership bullets):
- Ethan: move JIRA-7821 to in-progress and ping infra lead (target: 2026-10-07).
- Maya: get legal POA and add signoff comment on LAU-19 (target: 2026-10-08).
- Priya: finalize prompt set and upload to confluence + link to this sheet (target: 2026-10-09).
- Louis: open fallback-mapping PR and attach a small test harness (target: 2026-10-10).

OPEN QUESTIONS (for async sync):
- Who is primary APAC on-call day of pilot? (tagging ops leads in thread)
- Do we route telemetry to hosted console or customer-managed pipeline for this pilot? (affects privacy guardrails)

QUICK MEETING AGENDA (if we need a 10-min sync):
- 1) Check P0 blockers (2 min) 2) Confirm legal + billing (2 min) 3) Confirm canary eval owner & criteria (3 min) 4) Assign weekend coverage (3 min).

VERSION HISTORY (short):
- 2026-10-05 Priya: initial micro-sheet, seeded rows.
- 2026-10-08 Ethan: updated infra row, added JIRA ref.
- 2026-10-12 Maya: added legal note and updated ETA for quota bump.

LINKS / QUICK REFERENCES:
- Pilot spec (confluence): confluence:prod-ops/pilot-2026-10
- Billing ticket: billing:LAU-19
- Infra ticket: JIRA-7821

SHORT COMMENTARY FOR REVIEWERS:
- This is intentionally terse — please edit rows inline. If you add a row, add owner + ETA + followup channel. Keep rows <= 8 to remain one-screen for sprint stand.

-- end of sheet --
